# Context: codec-archive

Codec pipeline (filters + zstd, Encoder/Decoder, ReadContext) and the `.jix` archive format.
Ref convention: `array.rs`, `block.rs`, `common.rs`, `version.rs`, `schema/...` = under
`jix/src/archive/`; `codec/...`, `storage/...`, `util/...`, `ops/...`, `dtype.rs`, `error.rs` =
under `jix/src/`; the core `jix/src/array.rs` and `jix-py/...` are written in full.

## Purpose

- `Encoder` (`jix/src/codec/mod.rs:110-212`): runs the filter chain on one raw block, then zstd;
  `encode_bound` sizes the output. `Decoder` (`:250-322`): zstd into `dst` (or a pooled tmp),
  then the filters in reverse. `ReadContext` (`:395-458`): per-thread zstd `Decompressor` in an
  `UnsafeCell` + a `BufferPool` + arithmetic-error modes/warnings (the last belong to the ops
  error subsystem).
- Filters (`jix/src/codec/filter/`): `ByteShuffle` (SIMD via `fearless_simd` for itemsize
  2/4/8/16, scalar otherwise) and `BitShuffle` (3 passes: byte shuffle, 8x8 bit transpose,
  row swap; trailing `N mod 8` elements copied verbatim).
- Archive (`jix/src/archive/`): `ArchiveWriter`/`ArchiveReader` (`common.rs`), block table
  serialization `BlockArchiveWriter` / `BlockTable::read_content` + `BlockTableStorageRead` for
  `Owned` (heap) and `Mmap` (`block.rs`), the public `Array::read_from_*` / `write_to*` and the
  array-level header checks (`array.rs`), `Dtype::{from_proto,to_proto}` (`schema/conversions.rs`),
  and the version word (`version.rs`).

Wire layout of one ArrayV1 archive (all at `base_offset` = writer position at start):
`"jix1"` magic | uleb128-len `FileMetadata` | uleb128-len `ArrayHeader{shape:u64[], block_shape:u64[]}`
| uleb128-len `BlockTableHeader{dtype,nitems,block_size,codec,filters,ContiguousV1}` | TOC
`[Section;2]` (raw `{offset:i64 relative to base, size:u64}` for blocks_loc then block_data) |
zero padding to 8 (absolute stream position) | blocks_loc: `((nblocks+1)>>1) * BlockLocation2`
(24 bytes: `offset:[u64;2], len:[u32;2]`, two blocks per entry, `storage/block.rs:20-35`) |
block_data (compressed blocks, any order). See `block.rs:102-110`.

## Contracts

Provided by the codec:
- `Encoder::encode(data, dst)` (`codec/mod.rs:147`): errors if `data.len() % itemsize != 0`;
  needs `dst.len() >= encode_bound(data.len())` (zstd errors otherwise; under `cfg(miri)`
  `encode_bound(n) == n` and `dst.copy_from_slice(data)` PANICS unless lengths are equal,
  `:187-192`). Returns compressed length.
- `Decoder::decode(src, dst)` (`codec/mod.rs:270`): returns the number of bytes zstd produced
  (`nbytes`) but runs every filter over the WHOLE `dst.len()` regardless (`:314-318`). It does
  NOT check `nbytes == dst.len()`; the only caller, `BlockTable::read_block`
  (`storage/block.rs:171-195`), has just `debug_assert_eq!(nbytes, b_size_bytes)` (`:193`).
  zstd errors if the output would exceed `dst`. Caller must give `dst.len() % itemsize == 0`.
- `Filter::encode/decode(src, dst, dtype, pool)` (`filter/mod.rs:42-54`): `src.len() == dst.len()`
  (asserted, release too: `codec/filter/byte_shuffle.rs:28,136`, `codec/filter/bit_shuffle.rs:115,154`); byte shuffle
  also asserts `len % itemsize == 0`; bit shuffle accepts any length. `itemsize > 0` is NOT
  checked (division by zero at `codec/filter/byte_shuffle.rs:122,210`, `codec/filter/bit_shuffle.rs:117,156`); it is
  established for arrays by `params.tune` -> `check_dtype_size_nonzero` (`storage/params.rs:307`).
  Both filters write every byte of `dst` (the Encoder relies on this, see Unsafe inventory) and
  decode is the exact inverse of encode for the same dtype.
- `ReadContext` is `Send` (const-asserted `:459-462`) and `!Sync` (UnsafeCell/RefCell).
  `allocate_buf` returns a `PoolBuf` whose slice is the full (possibly larger, stale) allocation.

Relied on from other modules:
- `AlternatingBuffers::edit` (`util/mod.rs:372-403`): Init -> returns `(src, tmp1)`;
  Alternating -> swaps and returns `(old main, old secondary)`. Decoder parity logic
  (`codec/mod.rs:282-298`) depends on exactly this.
- `BlockTable::new` (`storage/block.rs:103-132`) only `debug_assert`s the blocks_loc length and
  per-block bounds; `read_block` uses safe slicing `block_data[offset as usize..][..len]`
  (`:189`), so bad locations panic (Owned) unless `block_data` itself is a bogus slice (Mmap).
- `ArrayBlockTableStorageBase::new` (`storage/compact.rs:191-212`): "the spec block shape must
  match the block geometry already encoded in `blocks`" (`:193`). The read path in
  `storage/compact.rs:260+` indexes blocks with `spec.block_shape()`.
- `compact_into_builder` (`jix/src/array.rs:1274-1440`) must emit every block index in `0..nblocks`
  exactly once with `compressed.len() <= u32::MAX`; `BlockArchiveWriter` verifies neither
  (an unwritten index stays `(offset 0, len 0)`).
- `core::io::Take: Seek` (std >= 1.89): positions are relative to the Take start (= archive
  base) and bounded by the initial limit; `seek_relative_to_base` (`common.rs:256-263`) relies on it.
- prost: default recursion limit (100) bounds nested struct dtypes in `from_proto`; unknown enum
  values read back as `Unspecified` via the generated getters; unknown oneof members give `None`.

Archive validation (untrusted input). Validated always (O(1)):
- magic (`common.rs:126-131`), archive type (`array.rs:448-454`), `ndim <= 8` (`:460`),
  `block_shape.len() == ndim` (`:462-467`), `0 < b <= max(s,1)` per dim (`:469-478`, checked
  AFTER `u64 as u32` truncation at `:468`), padded nitems fits u64 and block product fits u32
  (`:480-502`), block table nitems/block_size/nblocks agree with the header (`:510-530`), then
  `tune` (itemsize > 0, block shape again) via `ArrayBlockTableStorageBase::new` (`:534`).
- `read_content` (`block.rs:318-426`): codec present/known, `<= 4` filters all known, body
  description present, each section `0 <= offset && offset as u64 + size <= total_size`
  (`common.rs:267`, wrapping add, `total_size = len.unwrap_or(u64::MAX)`), `size % size_of::<T>() == 0`,
  Mmap: pointer aligned for T (`block.rs:490-494`), `block_size > 0` (after `as u32` at `:374`),
  `nitems % block_size == 0`, `blocks_loc.len() == (nblocks+1)>>1` (`:382-389`).
- `Dtype::from_proto` (`schema/conversions.rs:9-128`): alignment pow2 <= 32768, itemsize fits u16, dtype
  shape ndim/dims/product (u16) and nonzero (via `set_shape`), scalar kind/endianness/alignment/
  itemsize; struct: offsets fit u16, nested dtypes recursively, layout must pass
  `is_aligned_struct` or `is_packed_struct` (`dtype.rs:653-716`, u16 arithmetic).
- Strict only (`block.rs:392-412`): every block's `(offset, len)` lies inside block_data.
Trusted / NOT validated: compressed block contents beyond zstd's own frame checks; decompressed
length (see above); bool byte values (0/1); `lib_version_semver`; the uleb128 message length
(allocated before any bound check, `common.rs:161,209`); section ranges vs the actual file or
mmap length (only vs caller `len`); per-block buffer size `block_size * itemsize`; uniqueness /
overlap of block ranges (overlap is allowed); struct field-name uniqueness.

Unsafe fns with preconditions:
- `pub unsafe fn Array::read_from_file_mmap` (`array.rs:217`): documented precondition only "file
  not modified while mapped" (`:185-191`). Implicitly ALSO needs `[offset, offset+len)` to lie
  within the file, since sections are checked against `len`, not `mmap.len()` - undocumented.
  Python exposes it as safe `read_array(..., mmap=True, len=...)` (`jix-py/src/archive.rs:122-124`).
- `util::value_from_io::<T>` / `value_as_bytes` / `cast_slice{,_mut}` (`util/mod.rs:193-213,553-583`):
  T must be padding-free POD valid for every bit pattern. Used with `Header`, `[Section;2]`,
  `BlockLocation2` (all repr(C), no padding) - holds.
- `BlockTableStorageRead::read_section<T>` (not `unsafe` but generic over `T: Copy`): transmutes
  file bytes to T; sound only for POD T (callers use `u8`, `BlockLocation2`).

## Unsafe inventory

- `codec/mod.rs:161,170` `AlignedBytes::set_len(data.len())` after `clear()+reserve()`: exposes
  uninit bytes as `&mut [u8]` dst for filters. Relies on both filters writing every dst byte
  (true today; non-local: any new filter or early return breaks it).
- `codec/mod.rs:303` `&mut *self.inner.get()` on the context's decompressor: relies on
  `ReadContext: !Sync`, `Decoder: !Send`, and the `&mut` not outliving `decompress_to_buffer`.
- `codec/mod.rs:276-279` (safe code over unsafe `PoolBuf::as_mut_slice`, `buf_pool.rs:116`):
  tmp buffer holds uninit/stale bytes; if zstd writes `nbytes < dst.len()` the filters read
  them. NOT established (depends on file contents).
- `codec/filter/byte_shuffle.rs:82,107` (encode SIMD) and `:176,195` (decode SIMD) `get_unchecked` vector
  loads/stores: bounds follow from `nchunks*lanes <= nitems` and the asserts at `:54,162`. Local.
- `codec/filter/byte_shuffle.rs:128-129,216-217` scalar tail/generic `get_unchecked`: `i < nitems`,
  `b < itemsize`, dst asserted at `:123,211`; `len % itemsize == 0` only debug-asserted
  (`:120,208`) but floor division keeps indices in bounds. Local.
- `bit_shuffle.rs`: no unsafe (safe indexing; a bug there panics instead of UB).
- `common.rs:46`, `block.rs:168,234,251` `value_as_bytes` / `cast_slice` of POD headers: fine.
- `common.rs:125`, `block.rs:359-361` `value_from_io`; `common.rs:210-214` `Vec::set_len` on
  uninit then `read_exact`; `block.rs:452-457` `Vec<MaybeUninit<T>>` set_len + `cast_slice_mut`
  + `read_exact`: all hand UNINITIALIZED memory to the caller's `Read` impl. `read_from_reader`
  is a safe public fn taking any `impl Read + Seek`; a safe Read impl may read `buf` (std's Read
  docs call this out). std/BufReader/PyReader do not read it.
- `block.rs:459` `transmute::<Vec<MaybeUninit<T>>, Vec<T>>`: layout equality not guaranteed by
  std (works in practice; `from_raw_parts` is the sanctioned form).
- `block.rs:489-498` Mmap: raw pointer `mmap[offset..].as_ptr()` + `SendSyncPtr::new` +
  `len = section.size / size_of::<T>()`; later `slice::from_raw_parts` in `MmapData::as_ref`
  (`storage/block.rs:444-445`). Needs `[offset, offset + size)` inside the mapping and
  `size <= isize::MAX`. Established only: `offset <= mmap.len()` (slice index panics) and the
  overflow-prone `check_section_bounds` vs caller `len`. NOT established; depends on file
  contents and caller `len`.
- `array.rs:225` `memmap2::Mmap::map`: precondition forwarded to the caller of `read_from_file_mmap`.
- Consult: `storage/block.rs:216` `assert_unchecked_eq!` (element_type dtype == decoder dtype;
  established by `ET::from_dtype` in `BlockTable::new`), used by `write_content` (`block.rs:84`).

## Edge-case surface

- Zero-length dims: header must have `b == 1` there (`array.rs:473`); nitems 0, nblocks 0,
  empty sections; Mmap `mmap[offset..]` with `offset == mmap.len()` is fine. 0-d (`shape []`):
  empty products give nitems 1, block_size 1, nblocks 1 on both write and read paths.
- Partial edge blocks: written zero-padded (`jix/src/array.rs:1406-1409`); the archive always stores
  full blocks (padded nitems, `array.rs:479-496`).
- Itemsize: u16. Empty struct (itemsize 0) passes `from_proto`, rejected later by `tune`; the
  unused `BlockTable::read_from` (`block.rs:280`) does not reject it. Odd itemsizes (3, 5, 12,
  struct / inner shape) use the scalar byte-shuffle path and the generic bit-shuffle math.
- Bit shuffle with `n < 8`: `full_bytes == 0`, everything is "tail". Lengths not a multiple of
  itemsize: Encoder errors; byte shuffle asserts; bit shuffle copies partial bytes in the tail.
- bool/f16/complex: `ScalarKind` variants are not feature-gated (`dtype.rs:310-340`), so files
  load as `TypeDyn` regardless of features. bool bytes are never validated.
- Large sizes / 32-bit: `length as usize` (`common.rs:161`), `section.size as usize`
  (`block.rs:450,485`; Owned then hits `assert_eq!` panic at `common.rs:243`), `offset as usize`
  (`block.rs:488`, `storage/block.rs:189`), `block_size as usize * itemsize` (`storage/block.rs:180`,
  up to 2^32 * 65535). u64 header fields truncated to u32 before validation (`array.rs:468`,
  `block.rs:374`). Writer: `compressed.len() as u32` (`block.rs:221`, `storage/block.rs:306`),
  `try_product().unwrap()` on a u32 block product (`array.rs:421`).
- Adversarial lengths: uleb128 shift `<< (i*7)` overflows at the 10th byte (`common.rs:184`);
  message length reserved before reading (`:209`); `len=None` makes `total_size = u64::MAX`
  so section sizes are unbounded (`common.rs:116`, `block.rs:452`).
- Truncated files: Owned read -> `UnexpectedEof` errors; Mmap never reads through the reader
  for sections, so truncation is only caught if caller `len` is accurate.
- Multiple arrays per file: Section offsets are relative to `base_offset` (`block.rs:239-244`);
  readers use a Take started at the archive start; padding is to the ABSOLUTE stream position,
  so mmap reads at a different file offset than written fail the alignment check (clean error).
- Version: `VERSION_U64` written (`common.rs:48-51`), never read; `build_metadata` always 0
  (`version.rs:6`). Forward compat relies on unknown enums/oneofs turning into clean errors
  (`schema/conversions.rs:59-74`, `block.rs:330-333,349-351`). `todo.md:7` "document archive compatibility".

## Intentional behaviors

- `ArchiveValidation::Minimal` skips the per-block location scan; it is for trusted files
  (`archive/mod.rs:7-48`, Python docstring `jix-py/src/archive.rs:15-48`). Panics on bad block
  offsets in Minimal mode are within that contract; UB would not be. The enum docs' mention of a
  "monotonically non-decreasing" check is stale: blocks may be stored in ANY order
  (`block.rs:399-400`, `storage/block.rs:44-48`).
- `read_from_reader(len=None)` skips section bounds checks (`array.rs:110-117`).
- `write_to_with` on a compact source (also behind view/any/typed wrappers) copies compressed
  blocks and ignores `params` (`array.rs:338-340`, test `:1120-1151`).
- `write_to_file` uses `create_new` and fails if the file exists (`:259,282`, test `:922`).
- mmap read is `unsafe` because of external file modification (`:185-191`); Python's
  `mmap=True` documents the same caution (`jix-py/src/archive.rs:35-38`).
- Python append mode opens without O_APPEND and seeks to end on purpose (`jix-py/src/archive.rs:213-221`).
- Any filter combination (e.g. ByteShuffle then BitShuffle) is allowed (`codec/mod.rs:91-94`).
- Byte shuffle of itemsize 1 is a memcpy; bit-shuffle tail is copied verbatim (`codec/filter/bit_shuffle.rs:90-95`).
- Compression level must fit i8 (`codec/mod.rs:73-81`, tests `:475-491`).
- Big-endian targets/dtypes unsupported (compile-time asserts `codec/filter/bit_shuffle.rs:364-369`,
  `storage/block.rs:10-15`; big-endian dtype rejected `schema/conversions.rs:66-68`).
- `cfg(miri)` replaces zstd by memcpy (`codec/mod.rs:119-122,187-192,205-208,308-312`).
- Arithmetic warnings are de-duplicated by message (`error.rs:340`).
- Note: the Python bindings in this environment are a DEBUG build (overflow checks on); shipped
  wheels are release (no `overflow-checks` override in `jix/Cargo.toml`), so overflow panics seen
  in tests are silent wraps in production.

### Changed in c009869 (#87) - supersedes conflicting statements above (line numbers above refer to bb1ee2c)
- Block locations are stored with alignment 1 and the writer no longer pads (block.proto changed),
  so mmap works at any file offset (K7 fixed). Section bounds are checked against the mapping.
- Buffers handed to a user `Read` impl are zero-filled first (K4 fixed).
- The decoded block size is checked before the filters run (K1 / K17 fixed). Block sizes are
  bounded to 2**30 items (K18 / K24 fixed). archive/array.rs grew ~58 lines of validation.

### Changed in 6f8e220 (#88) and 7e93487 (#89) - supersedes conflicting statements above
- #89 / #88: the dtype proto gained `bool8` and struct dtypes from files must be padding-free;
  arrays of bool8 read from files are valid for any byte (K44 fixed).

### Changed in 4d11918 (#90) - supersedes conflicting statements above
- Untrusted lengths are no longer allocated up front: array reads grow the buffer as they go,
  sections are read in chunks, uleb128 lengths are capped at 10 bytes, section bounds use checked
  arithmetic, and u64 -> usize conversions are checked (K46-K48, K55, K56 fixed).
- Writing an archive to a file opened in append mode returns an error (K49). Vec<MaybeUninit<T>>
  is converted with from_raw_parts (K63). archive/array.rs (~90 lines) and common.rs (~85) changed.

## Hot spots

- Short decompression: what does a release build return when a block decodes to fewer bytes
  than `block_size * itemsize`? Triggers: a block with `len == 0` (passes Strict; zstd likely
  returns Ok(0) for empty input), a frame without content-size, a skippable frame. With filters,
  the uninit tail of the pooled tmp is permuted into `dst`; without, `dst` keeps stale pool bytes.
- Mmap section math (`block.rs:478-498` + `common.rs:267`): can a crafted Section produce a
  slice past the mapping or longer than `isize::MAX`? Is caller `len` > file size ever checked?
- Allocation driven by untrusted lengths: message length, section sizes with `len=None`,
  per-block buffers `block_size * itemsize` at read time (`storage/compact.rs` tmp buffers, `Decoder`
  tmp). Which ones abort (OOM) instead of erroring?
- SIMD byte shuffle (`codec/filter/byte_shuffle.rs:52-112,160-200`): the interleave/deinterleave rounds
  implement a bit-rotation of the (vector, lane) index; correct only if `fearless_simd`'s
  `interleave`/`deinterleave` act on the full vector (not per 128-bit lane) for u8x32/u8x64.
  Tests cover only levels the CI CPU has (`:291-381`); NEON and `Fallback` are not exercised on
  x86. Does the scalar tail start exactly at `n_elements_done`?
- Encode vs decode agreement: Decoder buffer parity for 1..4 filters; bit-shuffle forward
  (`:206-271`) vs inverse (`:277-333`) index formulas for non-power-of-two typesize.
- Read params leakage: `array.rs:532` keeps the caller's `block_shape_fixed_dims` and
  `block_size`; with any `false` entry `tune` rescales the block shape (`storage/params.rs:346-359`).
- Struct dtypes from files: u16 offset arithmetic in `is_aligned_struct`/`is_packed_struct`
  (`dtype.rs:671-682,704`) decides whether fields fit inside itemsize; consumers such as
  `SubDtype` (`ops/sub_dtype.rs:135,149`) trust it with unchecked offsets.
- Recent churn: #72 (`763a701`) switched pooled buffers to full-capacity slices and added the
  `[..len]` slicing in `codec/filter/bit_shuffle.rs:122,161` and `codec/mod.rs:279` - check every PoolBuf use
  slices to the requested size; #59 (`1de4704`) rewrote byte shuffle on `fearless_simd`;
  #76/#81 added the ReadContext error/warning state.

### Suspicions (unverified)

- `storage/block.rs:193` + `codec/mod.rs:314-320` - decompressed length is only debug-asserted;
  `len == 0` blocks (Strict-valid) or short frames expose uninit/stale bytes as array data in release.
- `common.rs:267` - `offset as u64 + size` wraps in release; with Mmap
  (`block.rs:485-498`) this yields `MmapData` far longer than the mapping
  -> `from_raw_parts` UB at `storage/block.rs:445` and OOB block reads.
- `block.rs:478-489` - Mmap sections bounded by caller `len` only, never `mmap.len()`;
  `read_array(path, mmap=True, len=<too big>)` (safe Python) can read past the mapping.
- `common.rs:161,209` - `reserve(len)` with an untrusted u64 length before any bound
  check: capacity-overflow panic or OOM abort on a tiny file (also `block.rs:452` with `len=None`).
- `common.rs:184` - `u64 << (i*7)` overflows for >= 10 continuation bytes (debug panic).
- `dtype.rs:673,682,704` via `schema/conversions.rs:113` - u16 wrap in release lets a crafted struct
  dtype place a field past itemsize; `ops/sub_dtype.rs:149` then reads out of bounds.
- `array.rs:532` - caller `block_shape_fixed_dims` survives; `tune` rescales, so
  `spec.block_shape()` disagrees with on-disk blocks (wrong data / panics; `write_to_with`
  then writes an inconsistent header at `:399-402`).
- `schema/conversions.rs:58` (+ no content check anywhere) - bool arrays from files can hold bytes > 1.
- `block.rs:221`, `storage/block.rs:306` - `compressed.len() as u32` silently truncates.
- `array.rs:468`, `block.rs:374` - `as u32` before validation accepts e.g.
  `block_size = 2^32 + 4` as 4 (low).
- `common.rs:125,210-214`, `block.rs:359-361,452-457` - uninit buffers passed to
  a user `Read` impl through safe `read_from_reader` (low, classic unsoundness).

## Review units

1. `codec-archive-codec-pipeline` (~1140 lines): `codec/mod.rs:1-469`, `codec/filter/mod.rs:1-61`,
   `codec/filter/byte_shuffle.rs:1-232`, `codec/filter/bit_shuffle.rs:1-381`.
   Consult: `util/mod.rs` (AlternatingBuffers 291-403), `util/buf_pool.rs`,
   `util/aligned_vec/mod.rs`, `storage/block.rs:171-195,315-410`, `jix/src/array.rs:1274-1440`.
   Focus: short decompression (nbytes < dst.len()) and uninit reads in `Decoder::decode`;
   SIMD byte-shuffle index math per lanes 16/32/64 x itemsize 2/4/8/16 and both shuffle
   branches; `get_unchecked` bounds for tiny/empty inputs; bit-shuffle inverse for odd
   typesize and n mod 8 != 0; buffer routing for 1..4 filters; filters writing every dst byte;
   miri memcpy length assumptions; decompressor UnsafeCell aliasing.
2. `codec-archive-archive-io` (~950 lines): `common.rs:1-274`, `block.rs:1-501`,
   `version.rs:1-129`, `archive/mod.rs:1-48`.
   Consult: `storage/block.rs`, `util/mod.rs:193-213,529-583`, core `io::Take` Seek impl,
   `jix-py/src/archive.rs`.
   Focus: `check_section_bounds` wrap + Mmap slices; Mmap vs real file length; allocation
   before validation; uleb128 overflow; Strict vs Minimal (panic vs UB) for both storages;
   uninit buffers to user `Read`; writer bookkeeping (unwritten blocks, u32 lens, base offsets,
   padding); 32-bit truncations.
3. `codec-archive-array-format-dtype` (~720 lines): `array.rs:1-537`,
   `schema/conversions.rs:1-174`, `schema/mod.rs:1-8`.
   Consult: `dtype.rs:578-716,840-876`, `storage/compact.rs:191-330`,
   `storage/params.rs:299-490`, `ops/sub_dtype.rs`, `jix/src/array.rs:1234-1440`,
   `jix-py/src/archive.rs`.
   Focus: header validation arithmetic and truncation; caller params leaking into the spec;
   struct dtype layout validation (u16 wrap) and its consumers; bool/scalar dtype checks;
   to_proto/from_proto round trip for every dtype form; write_to_with header vs block geometry;
   version / unknown-enum handling.
